title: Migrate Kanbus-web (deploy on the standard front end) onto the standard front end

comments.author: home
comments.text: Code migrated, not deployed (no hosting). Kanbus-web PR #2 (merged): web/projection.json + web/hooks.py replace web/projector.py (565) and reader/build.py (127) (-692; +243 hooks, +33 settings). Needed core additions (Papyrus 5.1.0): section introduction above listing + sort by order (PR #413), body_class hook, --from-dir (PR #408). Parity old build vs new, 87 URLs: 0 blocking, DOM identical on 71 pages. Hosting missing in kanbus-production (494166748521): only github-oidc-provider and CDKToolkit stacks exist; no Amplify CMS app, no kanbus-web-infra pipeline, no CloudFront/bucket, no hosted zone; kanb.us zone Z01800091FUWW7R6GS7GV is in the legacy account (authoritative per dig NS). Needs (README Deploy): deploy infra/pipeline stack, approve the GitHub connection, Google OAuth secrets for the CMS, import content, then the kanb.us zone move and Amplify domain detach in legacy, then alias/ACM on the distribution.

comments.author: home
comments.text: kanb.us is live (2026-10-21 UTC). Stack kanbus-web-site (infra/hosting/site-edge.yml, Kanbus-web PR 3) in kanbus-production 494166748521: retained S3 bucket + CloudFront (E2QN4C2OA5JEI, d1uyifkn0r5w3t.cloudfront.net), cert for kanb.us and www.kanb.us in the same account. DNS in the legacy-account zone Z01800091FUWW7R6GS7GV: kanb.us A/AAAA alias and www CNAME to the new distribution; ACM validation CNAMEs added there. The Amplify domain association for kanb.us on legacy app d2h5foxy5ng19a was removed (needed to free the alias); the app and its repo source are kept. Old Gatsby URLs redirect (301) to the new pages. Verified: 36 old URLs resolve 200 after redirect, sitemap and robots 200, www redirects to apex, polled with no non-200. Not done: the CMS app shell (needs GitHub App handshake and Google OAuth secrets); staging.kanb.us CNAME still points at the old Amplify distribution and no longer resolves to a site. Rollback: re-create the Amplify domain association (saved config in session scratchpad) and point the A alias back at d2xpv7jaltlgoe.cloudfront.net.
